author: homer
title: Iliad
summary: Twenty-four books on a few weeks in the tenth year of the Trojan War: the wrath of Achilles, its cost to Greeks and Trojans, and its end.

1.title: The Wrath
1.summary: Apollo’s plague, the quarrel of Agamemnon and Achilles, Achilles’ withdrawal, Thetis’ appeal to Zeus, and a quarrel among the gods ended by laughter.
